sloka: एवमुक्तो महातेजा मनस्वी रावणात्मजः।अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं तत्र दृष्ट्वा विभीषणम् ।। ६.८७.१० ।।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā manasvī rāvaṇātmajaḥ।abravīt paruṣaṁ vākyaṁ tatra dṛṣṭvā vibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.87.10 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken that way, highly energetic and strong minded Indrajith seeing Vibheeshana spoke to him harshly as follows.
